actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident contributed >30 in the last round, so no punishment. Wallet (9.15) is below the free‑rider threshold, and the rule only mandates a minimal contribution when wallet is above that threshold. Therefore I rest and broadcast a discouraging message.
